name: Blue Spirit's Scourge of the Arcane

system.description:
Range: 10 spaces

Area: 5-space-radius

You tap into the Blue Spirit's mastery of the arcane to weaponize the flow of magic in an area, causing it to harm mages as they draw upon aether.

Choose a point within 10 spaces. Whenever a creature within a 5-space radius of that point makes a check to cast a spell, that creature suffers 1 Damage per success on their casting check, to a maximum amount equal to your Soul. This damage ignores Armor.

You can spend 1 Resolve at the start of your turn to sustain this effect, choosing another point if you wish.
